tool_schemas.name: fetch_html
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL and returns the fetched content serialized as HTML, along with recorded upstream response metadata; the returned HTML is truncated by character using start_index (offset) and max_length (limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, headers is not an object, or start_index/max_length are negative or not numbers; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds their quota. Raises NOT_FOUND when the upstream returns 404, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream request fails or returns a non-success status other than 404.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 5000)

start_index.description: Start content from this character index (default: 0)

tool_schemas.name: fetch_markdown
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL and returns the fetched content converted to Markdown, along with recorded upstream response metadata; the Markdown output is returned as a character window using start_index (offset) and max_length (limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, headers is not an object, or start_index/max_length are negative or not numbers; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds their quota. Raises NOT_FOUND when the upstream returns 404, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream request fails or returns a non-success status other than 404.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 5000)

start_index.description: Start content from this character index (default: 0)

tool_schemas.name: fetch_txt
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL and returns the fetched content as plain text with HTML stripped, along with recorded upstream response metadata; the text is truncated by character using start_index (offset) and max_length (limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, headers is not an object, or start_index/max_length are negative or not numbers; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds their quota. Raises NOT_FOUND when the upstream returns 404, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream request fails or returns a non-success status other than 404.

url.description: URL of the website to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 5000)

start_index.description: Start content from this character index (default: 0)

tool_schemas.name: fetch_json
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL and returns the response parsed as JSON, along with recorded upstream response metadata; if truncation is applied, it is done as a character window on the produced JSON output using start_index (offset) and max_length (limit). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, headers is not an object, or start_index/max_length are negative or not numbers; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when the caller exceeds their quota. Raises NOT_FOUND when the upstream returns 404, UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream request fails or returns a non-success status other than 404, and UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY when the upstream response cannot be parsed as valid JSON.

url.description: URL of the JSON to fetch

headers.description: Optional headers to include in the request

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 5000)

start_index.description: Start content from this character index (default: 0)

tool_schemas.name: list_fetch_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists fetch request records visible to the authenticated API key, newest-first, with optional filtering by status, url, and time range. Returns a paginated result set and refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or FORBIDDEN if the key is not active.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that created the request

url_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the requested URL

cache_hit.description: Filter by whether the request was served from cache

requested_after.description: Only return requests requested at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp)

requested_before.description: Only return requests requested before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp)

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 50)

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response

include.description: Optionally include related http_responses and/or fetch_outputs in each item

tool_schemas.implementation:
def list_fetch_requests(status=None, tool_name=None, url_contains=None, cache_hit=None, requested_after=None, requested_before=None, page_size=None, page_token=None, include=None, order=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, base64

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0185000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0185000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _parse_rfc3339(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s.strip():
            return None
        t = s.strip()
        # Handle trailing Z
        if t.endswith("Z"):
            t = t[:-1] + "+00:00"
        try:
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t)
        except Exception:
            return None
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _dt_from_row(val):
        if not isinstance(val, str) or not val:
            return None
        dt = _parse_rfc3339(val)
        return dt

    def _b64e(obj):
        raw = json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")

    def _b64d(tok):
        if not isinstance(tok, str) or not tok:
            return None
        pad = "=" * (-len(tok) % 4)
        try:
            raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode((tok + pad).encode("ascii"))
            return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            return None

    start_t = time.time()
    usage = _load("usage_events.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    fetch_requests = _load("fetch_requests.json")
    http_responses = _load("http_responses.json")
    fetch_outputs = _load("fetch_outputs.json")

    # Ambient authentication: find any active key capable of serving requests
    api_key = None
    for k in api_keys:
        if isinstance(k, dict) and k.get("status") == "active":
            api_key = k
            break
    if api_key is None:
        # no usable key context in store
        # log call attempt with no api_key
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": "unknown",
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No authenticated API key context available")

    # Validate inputs
    if status is not None:
        if not isinstance(status, str) or status not in ["queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"]:
            # log
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid status")
    if tool_name is not None:
        if not isinstance(tool_name, str) or tool_name not in ["fetch_html", "fetch_markdown", "fetch_txt", "fetch_json"]:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid tool_name")
    if url_contains is not None and not isinstance(url_contains, str):
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "url_contains must be a string")
    if cache_hit is not None and not isinstance(cache_hit, bool):
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cache_hit must be boolean")
    if page_size is None:
        page_size_v = 50
    else:
        if not isinstance(page_size, int) or page_size < 1 or page_size > 200:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_size out of range")
        page_size_v = page_size
    if order is None:
        order_v = "requested_at_desc"
    else:
        if not isinstance(order, str) or order not in ["requested_at_desc", "requested_at_asc"]:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid order")
        order_v = order
    if include is None:
        include_v = []
    else:
        if not isinstance(include, list) or any((not isinstance(x, str) or x not in ["http_response", "output"]) for x in include):
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid include values")
        include_v = include

    ra = _parse_rfc3339(requested_after) if requested_after is not None else None
    if requested_after is not None and ra is None:
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "requested_after must be an RFC3339 timestamp")
    rb = _parse_rfc3339(requested_before) if requested_before is not None else None
    if requested_before is not None and rb is None:
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "requested_before must be an RFC3339 timestamp")

    # FORBIDDEN if key not active (tool description); but business rules elsewhere say reject if not active.
    if api_key.get("status") != "active":
        evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
        usage.append({
            "id": evt_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key.get("id", "unknown"),
            "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
            "event_type": "request_failed",
            "tool_name": "fetch_html",
            "http_status_code": None,
            "upstream_body_bytes": None,
            "returned_chars": None,
            "cache_hit": None,
            "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
            "updated_at": _now_iso()
        })
        _save("usage_events.json", usage)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key is not active")

    # Pagination token
    token_obj = None
    if page_token is not None:
        token_obj = _b64d(page_token)
        if not isinstance(token_obj, dict) or "cursor" not in token_obj or "order" not in token_obj:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid page_token")
        if token_obj.get("order") != order_v:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "page_token does not match requested order")

    cursor = token_obj.get("cursor") if isinstance(token_obj, dict) else None  # {"requested_at":..., "id":...}

    # Filter visible to authenticated API key: api_key_id must match
    rows = [r for r in fetch_requests if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("api_key_id") == api_key["id"]]

    if status is not None:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("status") == status]
    if tool_name is not None:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("tool_name") == tool_name]
    if cache_hit is not None:
        rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("cache_hit") is cache_hit]
    if url_contains is not None:
        q = url_contains.casefold()
        rows = [r for r in rows if isinstance(r.get("url"), str) and q in r.get("url").casefold()]
    if ra is not None:
        rows = [r for r in rows if (_dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at")) is not None and _dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at")) >= ra)]
    if rb is not None:
        rows = [r for r in rows if (_dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at")) is not None and _dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at")) < rb)]

    def _sort_key(r):
        dt = _dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at"))
        # None sorts last in both directions
        ts = dt.timestamp() if dt else float("-inf")
        return (ts, r.get("id") or "")

    reverse = (order_v == "requested_at_desc")
    rows.sort(key=_sort_key, reverse=reverse)

    # Apply cursor: exclusive
    if cursor is not None:
        if not isinstance(cursor, dict) or "requested_at" not in cursor or "id" not in cursor:
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid cursor in page_token")
        cdt = _parse_rfc3339(cursor.get("requested_at"))
        cid = cursor.get("id")
        if cdt is None or not isinstance(cid, str):
            evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
            usage.append({
                "id": evt_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
                "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
                "event_type": "request_failed",
                "tool_name": "fetch_html",
                "http_status_code": None,
                "upstream_body_bytes": None,
                "returned_chars": None,
                "cache_hit": None,
                "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
                "created_at": _now_iso(),
                "updated_at": _now_iso()
            })
            _save("usage_events.json", usage)
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid cursor in page_token")

        def _is_after(r):
            rdt = _dt_from_row(r.get("requested_at"))
            rid = r.get("id") or ""
            if rdt is None:
                return False
            if reverse:
                # descending: we already returned items with (rdt,rid) > (cdt,cid) in sort order; now keep strictly smaller
                if rdt.timestamp() < cdt.timestamp():
                    return True
                if rdt.timestamp() == cdt.timestamp() and rid < cid:
                    return True
                return False
            else:
                # ascending: keep strictly greater
                if rdt.timestamp() > cdt.timestamp():
                    return True
                if rdt.timestamp() == cdt.timestamp() and rid > cid:
                    return True
                return False

        rows = [r for r in rows if _is_after(r)]

    total = len(rows)
    page = rows[:page_size_v]
    has_more = total > len(page)

    # Build include maps
    http_by_req = {}
    out_by_req = {}
    if "http_response" in include_v:
        for h in http_responses:
            if isinstance(h, dict) and isinstance(h.get("fetch_request_id"), str):
                http_by_req[h["fetch_request_id"]] = h
    if "output" in include_v:
        for o in fetch_outputs:
            if isinstance(o, dict) and isinstance(o.get("fetch_request_id"), str):
                out_by_req[o["fetch_request_id"]] = o

    items = []
    for r in page:
        item = dict(r)
        if "http_response" in include_v:
            item["http_response"] = http_by_req.get(r.get("id"))
        if "output" in include_v:
            item["output"] = out_by_req.get(r.get("id"))
        items.append(item)

    next_cursor = None
    next_token = None
    if has_more and page:
        last = page[-1]
        next_cursor = {"requested_at": last.get("requested_at"), "id": last.get("id")}
        next_token = _b64e({"cursor": next_cursor, "order": order_v})

    # Record observable dynamics: log call
    latency_ms = int((time.time() - start_t) * 1000)
    evt_id = f"use_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"
    usage.append({
        "id": evt_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
        "fetch_request_id": "unknown",
        "event_type": "response_returned",
        "tool_name": "fetch_html",
        "http_status_code": None,
        "upstream_body_bytes": None,
        "returned_chars": len(items),
        "cache_hit": None,
        "occurred_at": _now_iso(),
        "created_at": _now_iso(),
        "updated_at": _now_iso()
    })
    _save("usage_events.json", usage)

    return {
        "items": items,
        "page_size": page_size_v,
        "order": order_v,
        "total": total,
        "has_more": has_more,
        "next_page_token": next_token,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_fetch_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single fetch request by id, optionally including its recorded upstream HTTP response metadata and produced output segment. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

include.description: Optionally include related records for this request

tool_schemas.name: cancel_fetch_request
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight fetch request. Transitions status from queued->cancelled or running->cancelled; refuses with CONFLICT if the request is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist (or is not visible), and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

tool_schemas.name: list_usage_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists usage/audit events for the authenticated API key, with optional filtering by event_type, fetch_request_id, and time range. Returns a paginated result set and refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

fetch_request_id.description: Filter events for a single fetch request id

occurred_after.description: Only return events occurring at or after this time (RFC 3339 timestamp)

occurred_before.description: Only return events occurring before this time (RFC 3339 timestamp)

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 100)

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response

tool_schemas.name: get_fetch_output
tool_schemas.description: Returns the produced output segment for a completed fetch request in the requested format, applying (or reapplying) the stored slicing window when start_index/max_length are provided. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the fetch request or output does not exist (or is not visible), CONFLICT if the request has not completed successfully, and UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid.

fetch_request_id.description: Fetch request id whose output should be returned

format.description: Output format to return; must match the request's tool_name-derived format unless the service can serve multiple renderings

start_index.description: Start content from this character index (default: stored start_index or 0)

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: stored max_length or 5000)

metadata.name: Fetch MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a lightweight web-fetching API that retrieves remote URLs and returns the response transformed into HTML, Markdown, plain text, or parsed JSON. It stores callers (API keys), each fetch request with its parameters, the upstream HTTP response metadata, and the produced output segme
